facts.fact: The medRxiv preprint reports that ScanForm, which transcribes handwritten HIV testing register pages with AI, reached 853 of 867 HIV testing facilities (98%) nationwide by September 2024 and captured 9,082,891 testing encounters to September 2025.

The preprint reports that ScanForm's error rate fell from 1.6% to 0.4% over 24 months, errors and deviations fell 58%, 99.8% of mandatory data elements were complete and about 94.6% of records were submitted on time.

systems.platform: AI transcription of photographed paper registers
systems.owner: Quantitative Engineering Design (proprietary); used in national HIV testing M&E
